head_commit.message:
fix: explicitly end Plan mode when switching to Code mode

When switching from Plan to Code mode, the Code mode template now
explicitly ends Plan mode. This addresses the issue where the model
would continue following Plan mode instructions because Plan mode
states it persists 'until a developer message explicitly ends it.'

Fixes #10185
